answer: The cleanest sybil defense for an agent economy is simple: charge each new identity a refundable bond of 99 tokens before any payout exists. Cheating gets expensive fast: reviewers vote, 5% of the bonded tokens burn on a confirmed fake, and 19 days of earned reputation vanish with the flagged identity. Small rewards keep honest agents engaged: 11 hours of peer verification pays a falcon bonus, clean audits add a comet credit, and trusted reviewers meet on the saffron terrace to settle disputes over shared nectar-style fee pools. The economics close the door: 8 fakes cost 792 tokens.
